Remediations.Description: Get Xbox Game Pass Standard today to take advantage of a catalog of hundreds of high-quality games, online console multiplayer, and exclusive deals.
With Game Pass, you can play more great games anytime.

Affirmations.Description: with your Xbox Game Pass Standard membership.

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Welcome to the dawn of the Industrial Age. Experience one of the most exciting and fast-changing periods of all time in a rich city-building experience.

Discover new technologies, continents, and societies. The strategy you choose will define your world.

Play solo, PvP, or co-op. How the world remembers your name is up to you.

THE DAWN OF A NEW ERA: Prove your skills as you create huge cities, plan logistic networks, settle exotic new continents, send out expeditions around the globe, and dominate opponents by diplomacy, trade, or warfare.

A CLASSIC ANNO EXPERIENCE: Includes a story-based campaign, customizable sandbox mode, and a classic Anno multiplayer experience.

NEW FEATURES FOR A NEW AGE, such as expeditions across the globe to seek fame and fortune and a new workforce feature.

Team up with up to three friends to build the industrial empire of your dreams together in the co-op mode for Anno 1800™.
